loyalty.title: Loyalty discount
loyalty.intro: A fixed discount you give a pharmacy on an order, by the order's value, on tiers you set and pay for. The pharmacy sees it in the cart and on the invoice. Feniq pays none of it and takes its share of what is left.
loyalty.example: Example: an order of 100,000 or more -> 2,000 off; 200,000 or more -> 5,000 off.
loyalty.errorTier: Each tier needs an order value above zero and a discount below it, in whole numbers.
loyalty.errorEmpty: Add at least one tier before turning it on.
loyalty.monthlyHelp: Delivered invoices count at their net amount after discounts and credit, within a Damascus calendar month. Only the incremental reward is credited for the next order. Returns reduce entitlement; a spent reward offsets future loyalty, without taking commission credit or creating cash debt. Monthly tiers freeze at the first delivery.
loyalty.monthlyExample: Example: 100,000 delivered net purchases → 1,000 credit; at 200,000 → 5,000 total, so only 4,000 more.

delivery.assignHint: Save the schedule first, then find the pharmacy and choose its region. This assignment does not hide warehouses in the catalog.
delivery.unavailable: Delivery time is not currently specified for this pharmacy.
delivery.preview: Preview; the estimate is fixed when you submit the order.
delivery.late: Past the arrival window. Contact the warehouse; the timer ending does not mean delivered.
delivery.until: Time until the end of the window
delivery.reason: Reason for change — visible to the pharmacy
delivery.invalid: Check region names, days and times. Hours 0–168, arrival up to 72. Do not repeat a weekday within a region.
delivery.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Save or reload before assigning pharmacies.

errors.INVALID_DELIVERY_SCHEDULE: Check region names, days and times. Hours 0–168, arrival up to 72. Do not repeat a weekday within a region.

analytics.title: Feniq platform analytics
analytics.scope: Recorded Feniq activity only. Not all warehouse or Syrian market sales. Net sales are not profit.
analytics.measurement: Order counts use creation date; chart and money use posted ledger dates. Pending orders are not sales. Returns and reversals reduce the net.
analytics.regionNote: Uses each pharmacy's currently registered city and area type. Missing locations stay unspecified; similar names are not guessed together. Posted amounts may relate to older orders.
analytics.demandNote: Top 20 by distinct non-cancelled orders containing a medicine, not stock or searches. Valid central catalog IDs unify medicines; unlinked items stay separate. Different pack units are not summed.
analytics.unlinked: Unlinked to central catalog — may appear under multiple names
analytics.retentionNote: Non-cancelled orders only. Retention is previous equal-duration buyers who ordered again now. Returning buyers were active earlier, skipped the previous window and returned now. This does not measure app use without orders.
analytics.timingNote: From creation to recorded event. Delivery includes currently delivered orders only; missing timestamps are excluded. Means are not delivery promises.
analytics.availabilityNote: Warehouses whose subscription policy currently permits each feature, not its users. Account authorization is a separate requirement. These are current states regardless of the selected report period.
analytics.usage: Recorded feature operations in this period
analytics.usageNote: Indicators from recorded operations, not every screen opening. Payments and reversals use ledger dates; orders exclude cancellations; visits require location and QR verification.
analytics.statuses: Current status of orders created in this period
analytics.empty: No recorded activity in this period

numericInput.invalid: Enter a valid number within the shown limits. Review the amount rather than removing digits to bypass this message.

maintenance.title: System maintenance & recovery
maintenance.intro: Inspect legacy demo warehouse records before cleanup. This page is read-only and cannot delete data.
maintenance.accountsBlocked: {{count}} warehouse accounts require password recovery or unblocking.
maintenance.cleanupBlocked: Final cleanup is locked until a restorable backup has been verified and associated financial records have been reviewed.
maintenance.restoreWarning: Before cleanup: create an encrypted database backup and confirm a successful restore drill in an isolated database. Opening a link does not establish backup success.
maintenance.notYetAutomated: Direct cleanup and restore are not yet enabled in this panel. These links open existing tools; this page does not trigger any deletion or automatic restore.

launch.title: Pharmacist launch status
launch.hint: Open ordering only after warehouses, prices and commission agreements are ready. Registration approval is separate.
launch.closesAt: Automatically stop accepting orders (device local time)
launch.closesAtHint: New orders are automatically refused after this time, even if Accept orders remains selected.
launch.autoCloseEnabled: Stop accepting orders automatically (recommended for pilot)
launch.deadlineWarning: Warning: Without a deadline, orders will remain open until manually closed.

featureControl.title: Feature Control Center
featureControl.help: Global switches affect all warehouses. Entitlements apply to the selected warehouse. Saving does not create charges or collect money.
featureControl.core: Catalog, core orders, invoices, financial records, payments, returns and settlements remain available according to account permissions.
featureControl.bundleHelp: Enter approved package contents only. No default prices. Changed contents require a new code and preserve previously issued rights.
featureControl.name: Approved bundle name
featureControl.preferencesHelp: Disable or re-enable features you are entitled to. Preferences cannot grant subscription rights.
featureControl.preferencesSaved: Saved and dashboard feature access refreshed.
featureControl.ownerIncluded: Owner mobile access is included automatically in the advanced tier; owner insights are separate.

states.rights_only: Entitlement prepared; mobile channel enforcement pending

featureControl.implementationLimits: Rep tracking currently records visits; alerts are in-screen. Sales reports and owner insights share the current report. Owner mobile rights do not block the legacy channel; advanced accounting is pending. Core payment recording remains available to accounting operators.
featureControl.chooseWarehouse: Select a warehouse to manage its rights and accounts

accounting.title: Accounting dashboard
accounting.scope: Period metrics cover the whole warehouse; debt is the current position, independent of period. Period:
accounting.invoiceNote: Payments are account-level. This report does not allocate payments to invoices or establish commission under the new collection policy.
accounting.activityScope: Up to 20 movements in the selected period and type. Open a pharmacy statement for full details.
accounting.activityLimit: More movements exist; open the pharmacy statement for details.
accounting.agingNote: Monitoring estimate using oldest debt first and the warehouse threshold; not invoice payment allocation. Read time is independent of the summary above.
accounting.noOverdue: No overdue receivables under current follow-up settings.
